The pilot processed 8.7 million readings from 126 meters. Average completeness was 99.2%, and 96.8% of intervals reached the catalogue within five minutes. Hourly products met the minimum rule of three meters in 98.6% of cases; remaining intervals were not exported.

Connector availability was 99.4%. Catalogue latency at the 95th percentile fell to 1.31 seconds after index optimization. Seven incidents were recorded, none involving data exposure. Partner queries mainly used hourly aggregates; daily products represented 18% of authorized downloads.

The final report must distinguish technical and privacy indicators. The absence of products blocked by the minimum-count rule will not be presented as a failure. Inés will validate counts, and Héctor will review the interpretation of privacy indicators before approval.
